item: the sound "a" as at the start of APPLE — "aaa" (never "ay")
the sound "b" as in BAT — one crisp "b"
the sound "c" as in CAT — one crisp "k"
the sound "d" as in DOG — one crisp "d"
the sound "e" as at the start of EGG — "eh" (never "ee")
the hard sound "g" as in GOAT — one crisp "g"
the sound "i" as at the start of IGLOO — "ih" (never "eye")
the sound "k" as in KITE — one crisp "k"
the sound "o" as at the start of OCTOPUS — "o" as in hot (never "oh")
the sound "q" as at the start of QUEEN — "kw"
the sound "r" — stretchy "rrr" as in run
the sound "u" as at the start of UMBRELLA — "uh" as in cup (never "you")
the sound "w" as in WEB — "wuh", as light as you can
the sound "x" as at the END of BOX — "ks"
the sound "y" as in YES — "yuh", as light as you can
the sound "th" as in THUMB (soft, no voice)
the sound "ng" as at the end of RING
the sound "ck" as at the end of DUCK — one crisp "k"

Woolly naps out in the sun,
on top the hay - what fun!
Bouncy hops up to the tent,
and that is where the day was spent.

A fox trots past the old farm gate,
the fish in Duck Pond swim so straight.
The dog naps by the big red barn,
while Muddy digs across the farm.
An otter plays down by the pond,
and Splashy quacks - she's very fond.
On top the hay the hens all camp,
at night old Clucky lights the lamp.
Speedy loves to run and run,
in a red hat in the sun.
Bouncy hops to the farm gate,
then they both run home - it's late!
The Meadow Pals played in the sun,
Woolly rolls the big round ball,
it bounces off the garden wall.
No wolf is near - just watch the sheep,
they play until they fall asleep.

beside the stream and little boat.
Zippy counts to six - what fun!
A pig naps in the sun.
A fox runs past the ferny den,
They drove the van to see the vet,
Sunny flies a bright red kite,
Honky pours from a big jug,
and Dozy gives a sleepy hug.

No sheep live in the Hollow here,
The dino pals all share the ball,
"Watch the little ant!" honks Honky's call,
"come play, come play - one and all!"
Little Cheeky and friends all like
the leafy path, the valley hike.
"No igloo here!" laughs Zippy with glee,
An otter swims where tall ferns grow more,
No ox lives in the Hollow, true,
just dino friends for me and you.

will put his cap beside the wall.

and lands with a happy thud.
Wren has found a glowing egg,

When Luna counts the stars to ten,
the Moonwood friends all play again.
A pink dawn lights the Moonwood trees,
and mushrooms bob in the soft breeze.

he loves to hear the Moonwood sing.
The friends all join the evening song,
and hum and gently sway along.

Which Moonwood friend is first to spring?

"Let's play again!" the friends all say,
